title: Invertibility of the resolution-defined qcqs flat base-change map
statement: For f:X→S quasi-compact and quasi-separated, g:S′→S flat, g′=pullback.snd g f flat, F a quasi-coherent O_X-module, I and J injective resolutions of F and g′*F, t:I→g′_*J an augmentation-preserving comparison lift, and p≥0, the specific sheaf morphism flatBaseChangeResolutionBeta f g I J t p is an isomorphism. This is the actual O_X-module-derived comparison, for arbitrary flat base change, not only an Ext cohomology dimension identity over field extensions. [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-resolution-construction] [def-sp-injective-resolutions] [pqf-def-coherent]

source.place: Lemma 30.5.2, part (1) and its proof: affine-local reduction, separated Cech proof and the qcqs Cech-to-cohomology spectral sequence; comparison map from 02N7.

proof.text: Reduce locally on S′ to affine flat base change. On a finite affine cover of the qcqs source, the Cech-to-cohomology spectral sequence computes derived module cohomology. For each quasi-compact separated intersection, refine by finite affine covers; quasi-coherent sections on affine intersections base change by tensor. The tensor functor is exact, so it commutes with the homology of these complexes and the spectral-sequence abutments. The scalar extension is therefore an isomorphism in every degree, including zero. This is the proof of Stacks 02KH, with ordinary module cohomology computed using its injective resolutions.

Identify the isomorphism with the specified resolution-defined sheaf comparison: both arise from the pullback unit, and the augmented lift gives that unit on cocycles. The section computation and independence of augmented lifts identify the map for all I,J,t. Local invertibility is invertibility of the sheaf morphism.

theorem Scheme.Modules.flatBaseChangeResolutionBeta_isIso
    {X S S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] [Flat g] [Flat (pullback.snd g f)]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F))
    (t : I.cocomplex ⟶
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd g f)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex)
    (ht : I.ι.f 0 ≫ t.f 0 =
      (Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
        (pullback.snd g f))).unit.app F ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd g f)).map (J.ι.f 0)) (p : ℕ) :
    IsIso (Scheme.Modules.flatBaseChangeResolutionBeta f g I J t p)
